cases.sentence: Он спросил ___, правда ли Бог сказал не есть с деревьев.
cases.translation: He asked the woman whether God had really said not to eat from the trees.
cases.explain: The transitive verb спросить takes its direct object in the accusative.

cases.sentence: Женщина ответила ___, что им можно есть плоды сада.
cases.translation: The woman answered the serpent that they could eat the fruit of the garden.
cases.explain: The verb ответить (to answer someone) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Не ешьте плодов с ___, которое посередине сада.
cases.translation: Do not eat the fruit of the tree that is in the middle of the garden.
cases.explain: The preposition с in the sense of 'from' governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Она дала плод и ___, который был с ней.
cases.translation: She also gave fruit to her husband, who was with her.
cases.explain: The verb дать takes an indirect object (the recipient) in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Они услышали, как Господь Бог ходит по ___.
cases.translation: They heard the Lord God walking through the garden.
cases.explain: The preposition по (movement over/through) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Я положу вражду между твоим ___ и ее потомком.
cases.translation: I will put hostility between your offspring and her offspring.
cases.explain: The preposition между governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Проклят ты больше любого ___ и всех диких зверей.
cases.translation: You are cursed more than any livestock and all the wild animals.
cases.explain: The comparative больше (more than) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Ты будешь ползать на ___ во все дни твоей жизни.
cases.translation: You will crawl on your belly all the days of your life.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location takes the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Из всех диких зверей, которых создал Господь Бог, самым хитрым был змей.
reading.question: Which creature was the most cunning of all the wild animals?
reading.explain: The text says that of all the wild animals 'самым хитрым был змей' (the serpent was the most cunning).

reading.ru: Женщина ответила, «Змей обманул меня, вот я и ела».
reading.question: What did the woman say when God asked what she had done?
options: The man told her to eat
She found the fruit on the ground
reading.explain: The woman answered 'Змей обманул меня' (the serpent deceived me).

reading.ru: Ты будешь ползать на брюхе, ты будешь есть прах во все дни твоей жизни.
reading.question: What did God say the serpent would eat all the days of its life?
reading.explain: God tells the serpent 'ты будешь есть прах' (you will eat dust).

reading.ru: Адам назвал свою жену Ева, потому что она стала матерью всех живущих.
reading.question: Why did Adam name his wife Eve?
options: Because she became the mother of all the living
Because she was the first woman
reading.correct: Because she became the mother of all the living
reading.explain: The text says he named her Eve 'потому что она стала матерью всех живущих' (because she became the mother of all the living).

reading.ru: Господь Бог сделал одежды из кожи и одел в них Адама и его жену.
reading.question: What did God make the clothing from for Adam and his wife?
reading.explain: The text says God made garments 'из кожи' (from skin/hide) and clothed them.

reading.ru: Изгнав человека, он поставил на востоке от сада Эдем Херувимов и вращающийся пламенный меч, чтобы охранять путь к дереву жизни.
reading.question: What did God place to guard the way to the tree of life?
reading.explain: The text says he set 'Херувимов и вращающийся пламенный меч' (cherubim and a turning flaming sword) to guard the way.
